verdict.rationale: Omarchy's manual documents keyboard-driven tiling, with `Super + T` to toggle a window between tiling and floating and `Super + L` to switch between the dwindle and scrolling layouts. A community user confirms the tiling fits their multitasking workflow, and another commenter describes Omarchy as a way to test drive Hyprland. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the available layouts and of snapping/moving windows into positions, evidence of more than two predefined layouts, broader hands-on corroboration of layout use.
